name: adaptorch
description: Run multi-step coding tasks on the hosted AdaptOrch service from Claude Code and get replayable run receipts and evidence back in the conversation.

api_token.title: AdaptOrch API key
api_token.description: Key from https://adaptorch.com/app/api-keys (starts with ado_). Leave empty to browse the tools before signing up; tool calls then return a setup error.

provider.title: Model provider
provider.description: Provider identifier from your AdaptOrch dashboard. Configure together with the model and provider key for model runs.

provider_model.title: Provider model ID
provider_model.description: Exact provider model ID. Model tokens are billed separately by the provider.

provider_key.title: Model-provider API key
provider_key.description: Provider key for model runs. Do not put it in a prompt or tool argument.
